ev.j_any_fire.title: Fire
ev.j_any_fire.text: A fire broke out in the quarter at night, and the flames have already reached the building where you work. Neighbours are shouting beyond the wall; somewhere children are crying.
ev.j_any_fire.text.rome: A fire broke out in the crowded quarter at night: the wooden upper floors of the tenements burn like straw. The flames have already reached the building where you work, and neighbours are shouting beyond the wall.
ev.j_any_fire.save_goods: Carry out the goods and tools
ev.j_any_fire.save_goods.success: You got almost everything out before the beams came down. You coughed for a week, but the business is saved.
ev.j_any_fire.save_goods.failure: A beam crashed down right beside you. The burns took long to heal, and nothing was saved from the fire.
ev.j_any_fire.save_people: Help the neighbours get children and old people out
ev.j_any_fire_gratitude.title: A Debt from That Night
ev.j_any_fire_gratitude.text: The little girl you once carried out of a burning house has grown up. She sought you out and brought a gift from her whole family, along with a gratitude no coins could measure.
ev.j_any_new_tax.title: A New Levy
ev.j_any_new_tax.text: A new levy on your trade has been announced: now every sale and every bale at the city gates owes a share to the treasury. Others in your trade grumble and whisper.
ev.j_any_new_tax.text.rome: A new toll has been imposed: at the city gates and in the harbours a share is taken from every bale, and the tax farmers, the publicani, watch the goods more keenly than any guard.
ev.j_any_new_tax.text.athens: The Assembly has voted a new market due: the right to trade in the agora now costs more and more often, and the collectors know every face.
ev.j_any_new_tax.text.egypt: The farmers of the royal taxes have announced a new levy: in Ptolemaic Egypt every trade pays, from brewer to weaver, and the tax farmer's scribes are already going from shop to shop with their tablets.
ev.j_any_new_tax.evade: Hide part of your goods from the collectors
ev.j_any_new_tax.evade.success: The collectors never looked under the sacks of straw. Money saved, and nobody the wiser.
ev.j_any_new_tax.evade.failure: The collector found what you'd hidden. The fine is twice the levy, and now you're known as a sly one.
ev.j_any_new_tax.petition: Gather others in your trade and submit a petition
ev.j_any_new_tax.petition.success: A petition from a whole trade is hard to brush aside. The levy was lowered, and now you're the one they call on to speak for everyone.
ev.j_any_new_tax.petition.failure: Nobody even read the petition. The levy stayed, and you lost a day's work besides.
ev.j_any_payday.title: Where's My Money?
ev.j_any_payday.text: The work is delivered, but the client keeps putting off payment: "any day now", "after the festival", "when the ship comes in". You've been hearing it for two months.
ev.j_any_payday.shame: Confront him in public and demand what you're owed
ev.j_any_payday.shame.success: In front of the neighbours he was ashamed, and the money appeared at once, with apologies.
ev.j_any_payday.shame.failure: He shouted that you were a slanderer, and half the street believed him.
ev.j_any_payday.court: Take a complaint to a judge
ev.j_any_payday.court.success: The judge heard you both and ordered the debt paid, with something extra for your trouble.
ev.j_any_payday.court.failure: The client brought witnesses who claimed the work was poor. The case cost money, and the debt was lost anyway.
ev.j_farm_measure.title: A Crooked Measure
ev.j_farm_measure.text: The grain buyer has come for your harvest. Looking closely at his measure, you see its bottom raised by a good finger's width. Every measure holds less than it should, so you'll be paid less for the same grain.
ev.j_farm_measure.text.egypt: It's time to deliver grain to the royal granary. Looking closely at the measure the granary keeper uses for the artabas, you see its bottom raised by a good finger's width. Every measure holds less than it should, so more of your grain will be taken than is due.
ev.j_farm_measure.accept: Say nothing and hand over the grain
ev.j_farm_measure.expose: Expose the cheat in front of everyone
ev.j_farm_measure.expose.success: You poured the grain into a neighbour's honest measure for all to see. The cheat turned crimson and paid in full, and the neighbours remembered it.
ev.j_farm_measure.expose.failure: The cheat swore by every god that the measure was honest and found witnesses. The grain went cheap, and you made an enemy.
ev.j_farm_measure.town: Take the grain to town yourself
ev.j_farm_new_way.title: A New Way
ev.j_farm_new_way.text: A neighbour who served in distant lands says that there they sow beans or vetch on the resting field, and a year later the wheat stands like a wall. The village elders laugh: "The soil doesn't like inventions."
ev.j_farm_new_way.text.egypt: The next village has set up a water wheel with pots on its rim: an ox walks in a circle and lifts water from the canal even after the Nile has gone down. The wheel isn't cheap, but a second harvest in a year is a second harvest.
ev.j_farm_new_way.try: Try it on the whole field
ev.j_farm_new_way_pays.title: A Different Field
ev.j_farm_new_way_pays.text: Years have passed, and anyone walking by can see the difference: your field yields more than any other around. The neighbours keep peering over the fence.
ev.j_farm_new_way_pays.share: Show the neighbours how you did it
ev.j_farm_new_way_pays.keep: Let them work it out themselves
ev.j_farm_buyout.title: An Eye on Your Land
ev.j_farm_buyout.text: A rich neighbour is buying up the land around and has sent his steward with an offer: a good price for your plot, today, while his master is in the mood.
ev.j_farm_buyout.text.rome: A senator from Rome is assembling a great estate to be worked by slaves and has already bought out half the village. His steward offers a good price for your plot, today, while his master is in the mood.
ev.j_farm_buyout.sell: Sell and move to the city
ev.j_farm_buyout.refuse: Refuse: this is the land of my ancestors
ev.j_farm_squeeze.title: The Neighbour's Herds
ev.j_farm_squeeze.text: The rich neighbour never forgave your refusal. His herdsmen "accidentally" let cattle into your crops, and the water from the shared ditch has suddenly stopped reaching your field.
ev.j_farm_squeeze.endure: Endure it and mend the fence
ev.j_farm_squeeze.law.success: The judge disliked the rich neighbour even more than you did. You were awarded damages, and the herdsmen now steer well clear of your field.
ev.j_farm_squeeze.law.failure: The neighbour had witnesses and a good advocate. You lost the case, and the costs ate up your savings.
ev.j_farm_squeeze.sell_now: Sell the land while it still fetches a price
ev.j_lab_crane.title: Work at a Height
ev.j_lab_crane.text: At the temple building site they're raising columns with a great treadwheel crane, with men walking inside the wheel. The foreman wants someone to climb the scaffolding and guide the stone into place. Double pay.
ev.j_lab_crane.text.rome: At the aqueduct building site they're raising stone blocks with a great treadwheel crane, with men walking inside the wheel. The foreman wants someone to climb the scaffolding and guide the stone into place. Double pay.
ev.j_lab_crane.take.success: The stone settled into place. You climbed down on shaking knees with double pay in your fist.
ev.j_lab_crane.take.failure: The rope jerked and you fell from the scaffolding. The bones took long to knit, and the foreman paid for only half a day.
ev.j_lab_crane.ropes: Demand a safety rope and a partner
ev.j_lab_crane.ropes.success: The foreman grumbled but gave you a rope. You worked calmly, and others began demanding the same.
ev.j_lab_crane.ropes.failure: "Don't like it? Go home," said the foreman, and called someone else.
ev.j_lab_walkout.title: Tools Down
ev.j_lab_walkout.text: Wages on the building site have been held back for two months. The workers have decided to put down their tools and not return until the contractor pays.
ev.j_lab_walkout.text.egypt: Wages on the royal works have been held back for two months. Following an old custom, the workers have decided to leave the village and sit in the temple, where no one may touch them, until the officials listen.
ev.j_lab_walkout.join.success: A week later the contractor gave in: everything was paid, down to the last coin.
ev.j_lab_walkout.join.failure: The contractor hired others and didn't take back those who left. You had to look for work all over again.
ev.j_lab_walkout.lead.success: You spoke so firmly that the contractor paid the debt and even added something for the wait. The workers look at you differently now.
ev.j_lab_walkout.lead.failure: The contractor called you the ringleader and threw you out first. The others were paid; you weren't.
ev.j_lab_spokesman.title: They Remember You
ev.j_lab_spokesman.text: Years have passed, but the workers haven't forgotten who spoke for them back then. Now the contractor needs a head for the work gang, and everyone points at you.
ev.j_art_client.title: A Noble Client
ev.j_art_client.text: A man from a noble house came into the workshop. His master wants something no one else owns: a gift the whole city will talk about.
ev.j_art_client.text.rome: A freedman of a general preparing his triumph came into the workshop. His master wants silver cups for the feast like no one else's; all Rome should talk about them.
ev.j_art_client.text.athens: A wealthy choregos came into the workshop: his chorus won at the festival, and he wants to dedicate a gift to the temple like no other. All Athens should talk about it.
ev.j_art_client.text.egypt: A courtier from Alexandria came into the workshop. He needs a gift for King Ptolemy, something no one else in all Egypt owns.
ev.j_art_client.masterpiece: Make the best thing you're capable of
ev.j_art_client.masterpiece.success: The client turned the piece in his hands in silence for a long time, then paid twice the agreed price.
ev.j_art_client.masterpiece.failure: You worked through the nights, but on the last day a crack ran through the piece. You had to let it go for half the price.
ev.j_art_client.standard: Make it well, but as usual
ev.j_art_client_returns.title: A Master's Fame
ev.j_art_client_returns.text: Your work is still shown to guests in that noble house. They ask whose hands made it, and clients you never dared dream of come to your door.
ev.j_art_corners.title: A Third Cheaper
ev.j_art_corners.text: An army supplier has ordered a large batch of buckles and arrowheads, and he hints that if you use poorer metal no one will notice, and the difference is yours. But your maker's stamp is on every piece.
ev.j_art_corners.haggle: Do it properly, but bargain for a better price
ev.j_art_corners.haggle.success: The supplier grimaced but agreed: good work is harder to find than cheap work.
ev.j_art_corners.haggle.failure: The supplier went to another craftsman. Clear conscience, empty purse.
ev.j_art_corners_found.title: A Stamp on the Fragment
ev.j_art_corners_found.text: They say a whole unit on campaign had its buckles snap and its arrowheads bend, and your stamp was found on the pieces. Soon it will be talked about at every stall.
ev.j_art_corners_found.deny: Deny it: the stamp could have been forged
ev.j_art_corners_found.deny.success: Nothing could be proven. But for a long time you flinched whenever someone looked closely at your stamp.
ev.j_art_corners_found.deny.failure: Witnesses had seen you buying cheap metal. Disgrace and a fine.
ev.j_art_apprentice.title: An Apprentice
ev.j_art_apprentice.text: A widow from the next street brought her son: "Take him as an apprentice, I have nothing to feed him." The boy looks at your tools the way you once did.
ev.j_art_apprentice.text.egypt: A widow from the next street brought her son: "Take him as an apprentice, I have nothing to feed him." As is the custom, a contract will be drawn up on papyrus: so many years of training, so much bread and clothing. The boy looks at your tools the way you once did.
ev.j_art_apprentice.take: Take him and teach him properly
ev.j_art_apprentice.fee: Take him, but only for a fee
ev.j_art_apprentice_grown.title: The Apprentice Grown
ev.j_art_apprentice_grown.text: The boy you once took on has become a master, in some things already better than you. He plans to open his own business and has come to ask your advice.
ev.j_art_apprentice_grown.bless: Give him your blessing and let him go
ev.j_art_apprentice_grown.forbid: Warn him: this street isn't big enough for two
ev.j_weave_merchant.title: Price per Piece
ev.j_weave_merchant.text: The cloth dealer who supplies your wool and buys your cloth has cut his rate again. The other weavers on the street suggest agreeing among yourselves to sell to him only at the old price.
ev.j_weave_merchant.text.egypt: The royal buyer has cut the rate for linen cloth again: in Egypt weaving is under the treasury's eye, and officials set the price. The other weavers on the street suggest standing together for the old price.
ev.j_weave_merchant.together.success: The buyer went round the whole quarter, couldn't find a single weaver willing to give in, and restored the old price.
ev.j_weave_merchant.together.failure: One of the women secretly accepted his price, and the agreement fell apart. Now you get work last.
ev.j_weave_merchant.market: Sell your cloth at the market yourself
ev.j_weave_pattern.title: Your Own Pattern
ev.j_weave_pattern.text: You came up with a border like no one else's: a wave turning into a vine. Less than a month later, the woman across the street was selling the same one.
ev.j_weave_pattern.new_one: Invent a new pattern, even better
ev.j_weave_pattern.confront: Tell her what you think in front of everyone
ev.j_weave_pattern.confront.success: The neighbours judged the pattern to be yours, and the copier stopped weaving it.
ev.j_weave_pattern.confront.failure: She claimed her grandmother wove that pattern. Many believed her instead of you.
ev.j_weave_pattern.teach_all: Teach the pattern to anyone who wants it
ev.j_weave_pattern_later.title: Your Border in Fashion
ev.j_weave_pattern_later.text: Your pattern has spread across the city and is called by your name. A wealthy lady sought out "that weaver" and ordered cloth for her daughter's entire dowry.
ev.j_mid_physician.title: A Physician at the Bedside
ev.j_mid_physician.text: You were called to a woman in labour in a rich house, but the household physician is already giving orders. He insists on doing it his way, and you know from experience it will only make things worse.
ev.j_mid_physician.insist.success: The birth went well, and the lady of the house said before everyone that without you it would have ended badly. The physician kept quiet.
ev.j_mid_physician.insist.failure: The birth was hard, and the physician loudly declared your arrogance to blame. Mother and child are alive, but the rumour has spread.
ev.j_mid_blame.title: The Evil Eye
ev.j_mid_blame.text: A baby you delivered was born weak and didn't live a month. The family's grandmother whispers in the street that the midwife has the evil eye.
ev.j_mid_blame.face: Go out to people and tell them how it was
ev.j_mid_blame.face.success: You spoke calmly and honestly. The women remembered how many children you'd brought into the world alive, and the talk died down.
ev.j_mid_blame.face.failure: The more you explained, the less they believed you. Several families called another midwife.
ev.j_mid_blame.temple: Go to the temple for a purification rite
ev.j_mid_blame.mother: Go to the baby's mother and simply be with her
ev.j_mid_book.title: A Physician with Tablets
ev.j_mid_book.text: A learned Greek physician is writing a book on women's ailments and childbirth. He asks to accompany you on your calls and write down everything you do.
ev.j_mid_book.refuse: Refuse: a man has no business at a birth
ev.j_mid_book_later.title: A Book on Childbirth
ev.j_mid_book_later.text: That physician's book has spread from city to city. Young midwives recite your own methods to you, read from its pages, and the richest families now call only for you.
ev.j_merch_inspector.title: Checking the Weights
ev.j_merch_inspector.text: A market inspector is going round with the official weights. He weighed yours, and they came up light. You bought them along with the shop and never checked.
ev.j_merch_inspector.text.rome: The aedile's men are going round the market with the official weights. They weighed yours, and they came up light. You bought them along with the shop and never checked.
ev.j_merch_inspector.text.athens: The agoranomos, the market overseer, is going round the agora with the city's weights. He weighed yours, and they came up light. You bought them along with the shop and never checked.
ev.j_merch_inspector.bribe.success: The coin vanished into his sleeve, and the inspector moved on as if he'd noticed nothing.
ev.j_merch_inspector.bribe.failure: The inspector turned out to be honest. The fine is now doubled, and the market whispers about a bribe.
ev.j_merch_inspector.retest: Demand a reweighing on the standard scales at the temple
ev.j_merch_inspector.retest.success: The standard scales showed it was the inspector's own weights that had been filed down. He had to apologize before the whole market.
ev.j_merch_inspector.retest.failure: The standard confirmed it: your weights are light. The fine went up, and now you're known as a troublemaker too.
ev.j_merch_hoard.title: A Hungry Year
ev.j_merch_hoard.text: The harvest failed, the grain ships are late, and prices rise every day. Your storehouse is full. Hold the goods back another month and you can sell at three times the price.
ev.j_merch_hoard.text.athens: The harvest failed, the grain ships from the Black Sea are late, and prices rise every day. In Athens, hoarding grain beyond the legal limit is judged harshly, but the grain wardens can't watch every storehouse. Yours is full.
ev.j_merch_hoard.text.egypt: The Nile flood was low, the harvest is poor, and bread prices rise every day. Your storehouse is full. Hold the goods back another month and you can sell at three times the price.
ev.j_merch_hoard.give: Give part of the grain to the poor
ev.j_merch_hoard_later.title: An Old Grudge
ev.j_merch_hoard_later.text: Years have passed, but the city remembers who grew rich on the famine. You're summoned to court: the neighbours remember the locked storehouse and the hungry queues.
ev.j_merch_hoard_later.defend.success: You proved that everyone had raised their prices. The court let you go, though the sidelong looks remained.
ev.j_merch_hoard_later.defend.failure: The court decided to make an example of you. A huge fine, and a name people will long say through gritted teeth.
ev.j_merch_branch.title: A Call to Alexandria
ev.j_merch_branch.text: Your partner writes from Alexandria: here is the finest harbour in the world, where goods from India and Arabia arrive. He needs someone reliable to set up a business with him.
ev.j_merch_branch.agent: Send a trusted freedman in your place
ev.j_merch_branch.agent.success: The freedman proved capable: within a year came money and a letter with new orders.
ev.j_merch_branch.agent.failure: The freedman settled in Alexandria and seems to be trading for himself now. The money is gone.
ev.j_merch_branch_later.title: The Alexandrian Shop
ev.j_merch_branch_later.text: The Alexandrian business has grown: you have a warehouse by the Great Harbour and clerks who speak three languages. Ships from all over the sea know your name.
ev.j_sail_late.title: A Late Voyage
ev.j_sail_late.text: It's already November, and by custom the sea is closed until spring. But the captain is in a hurry: the cargo is valuable, the pay is double. He needs men who aren't afraid of winter storms.
ev.j_sail_late.sail.success: The wind was vicious, but you broke through. In port they looked at you like heroes, and paid you like heroes too.
ev.j_sail_late.sail.failure: The storm caught you off the cape. The ship survived by a miracle, and you only just.
ev.j_sail_late.persuade: Persuade the captain to wait for spring
ev.j_sail_late.persuade.success: The captain grumbled but stayed. A week later another ship was wrecked on the cape, and the captain poured you wine in front of everyone.
ev.j_sail_late.persuade.failure: The captain wouldn't listen and hired others. You were left without winter earnings.
ev.j_sail_trireme.title: Three Obols or Four
ev.j_sail_trireme.text: The treasury is empty, and the trireme's rowers are paid half, and late at that. Meanwhile the Spartan admiral, flush with Persian silver, promises rowers four obols a day, and many are already slipping over to the enemy at night.
ev.j_sail_trireme.demand: Go to the trierarch with your comrades
ev.j_sail_trireme.demand.success: The trierarch, a wealthy man, made up the rowers' pay from his own purse. The ship kept its full crew.
ev.j_sail_trireme.demand.failure: The trierarch shouted at you and threatened a lawsuit. No more money, only resentment.
ev.j_sail_trireme.desert.success: The Spartans paid generously. But the road home to Athens is closed to you for a long time.
ev.j_sail_trireme.desert.failure: You were caught on the shore. Beaten, stripped of your pay, and now no one on the ship will speak to you.
ev.j_sail_jettison.title: Cargo Overboard
ev.j_sail_jettison.text: The storm has raged for three days, and the ship is taking water. The captain orders the cargo thrown over, but the merchant who owns the amphorae clings to them, shouting he won't give up a single one. Under the Rhodian sea law, the loss is later shared among everyone whose cargo survives.
ev.j_sail_jettison.own_first: Throw your own small goods over first
ev.j_sail_jettison.side_merchant: Help the merchant: bail water as long as the ship holds
ev.j_sail_jettison.side_merchant.success: You bailed until dawn, and the ship held. The merchant embraced you and promised never to forget.
ev.j_sail_jettison.side_merchant.failure: The ship nearly capsized. The cargo went over anyway, and you wrecked your back on the buckets.
ev.j_leg_watch.title: The Sleeping Sentry
ev.j_leg_watch.text: Night rounds of the camp. By the rampart, leaning on his spear, your tentmate is asleep. Sleeping on watch is the gravest offence in the legion, and its punishment is merciless.
ev.j_leg_watch.wake: Shake him awake and tell no one
ev.j_leg_watch.wake.success: He leapt up white as chalk. A minute later the tribune passed by and noticed nothing. From that night on you're a brother to him.
ev.j_leg_watch.wake.failure: The tribune spotted you both. He got it worse, but your pay was docked too, and you were put on barley bread outside the camp.
ev.j_leg_watch.ignore.success: The night passed quietly. In the morning you couldn't look him in the eye.
ev.j_leg_watch.ignore.failure: At dawn the sleeper was found, and the whole tent was punished, you along with the rest.
ev.j_leg_bribe.title: The Price of Rest
ev.j_leg_bribe.text: The centurion openly takes money for exemptions from fatigue duty: those who pay don't dig ditches or haul logs. Those who don't get the dirtiest jobs.
ev.j_leg_bribe.complain.success: The tribune was one of the honest ones. The centurion was rebuked before everyone, and the extortion stopped, for a while at least.
ev.j_leg_bribe.complain.failure: The tribune waved it off, and the centurion found out who had complained. All year you got the worst duties.
ev.j_leg_donative.title: The General's Promise
ev.j_leg_donative.text: The general is leading the legions on Rome against his enemies and promises every soldier a generous gift of silver. The centurions watch to see who cheers loudest.
ev.j_leg_donative.cheer: Cheer loudest of all and take the silver
ev.j_leg_donative.silent: Keep quiet and take it like everyone
ev.j_leg_donative.speak: Say aloud that this is war on your own people
ev.j_leg_donative.speak.success: Many heard your words, and a few comrades stood with you. They left you alone, and later remembered you as an honest man.
ev.j_leg_donative.speak.failure: Your own comrades roughed you up in the tent that night and took your share. Since then you've held your tongue.
ev.j_leg_veteran_land.title: Land for Veterans
ev.j_leg_veteran_land.text: The victorious general keeps his word: veterans are allotted land in a new colony. You've been given a plot with olive trees and a stream.
ev.j_leg_veteran_land.settle: Retire and settle on the land
ev.j_leg_veteran_land.sell: Sell the allotment and keep serving
ev.j_sol_recruiter.title: The Recruiter
ev.j_sol_recruiter.text: A recruiter has appeared in the harbour: a king across the sea needs Greek mercenaries and pays in gold. They say men who come back from such campaigns buy themselves houses.
ev.j_sol_recruiter.text.athens: A recruiter for a Persian satrap has appeared in Piraeus: his master needs Greek hoplites and pays in gold darics. They say men who come back from such campaigns buy themselves houses.
ev.j_sol_recruiter.text.egypt: A recruiter has arrived in Alexandria: the king is raising an army for a campaign in Syria and pays in advance. They say men who come back from such campaigns buy themselves houses.
ev.j_sol_recruiter.haggle: Bring the recruiter men from your home town for a cut
ev.j_sol_recruiter.haggle.success: You brought a dozen sturdy lads, and the recruiter honestly counted out your share.
ev.j_sol_recruiter.haggle.failure: The lads laughed at you, and the recruiter sailed off without them.
ev.j_sol_return_rich.title: Gold from Overseas
ev.j_sol_return_rich.text: You've come back from the distant campaign, older, scarred, and with a belt heavy with foreign coins. At home they barely recognized you.
ev.j_sol_grain.title: Sacks of Grain
ev.j_sol_grain.text: The garrison commander is selling grain from the soldiers' rations on the side and issuing you half. You saw the sacks being loaded onto a cart at night with your own eyes.
ev.j_sol_grain.report.success: The strategos sent an inspection. The commander was removed, the rations restored, and you were commended.
ev.j_sol_grain.report.failure: The commander learned of the report before the inspection came. For a month you stood the coldest watches and cleaned out the latrines.
ev.j_sol_grain.share: Take a cut for keeping quiet
ev.j_sol_grain.silent: Say nothing and tighten your belt
ev.j_sol_grain_later.title: The Inspection
ev.j_sol_grain_later.text: Many years later, inspectors are going through the garrison's old accounts. The names of those who took a cut for their silence have surfaced, and yours is among them.
ev.j_sol_grain_later.deny.success: Nothing could be proven. But for a long time the word "inspection" made you flinch.
ev.j_sol_grain_later.deny.failure: A witness turned up. You had to pay back threefold, and a thief's reputation now walks ahead of you.
ev.j_sol_kleros.title: The Kleros
ev.j_sol_kleros.text: King Ptolemy rewards his soldiers with land. You've been given a kleros, a plot by a canal in the Fayum. The land is good, but who will work it while you're in service?
ev.j_sol_kleros.lease: Lease the plot to Egyptian farmers
ev.j_sol_kleros.farm: Work the land with your family
ev.j_sol_kleros.sell: Secretly sell the right to the plot
ev.j_sol_kleros.sell.success: A buyer turned up quickly, and the scribes looked the other way for a small consideration.
ev.j_sol_kleros.sell.failure: The deal was uncovered: a kleros is royal land and can't be sold. The money was taken, and you were fined.
ev.j_scr_forgery.title: A Small Correction
ev.j_scr_forgery.text: A rich client asks you to rewrite his late uncle's will, "just a little": one name, one figure. He lays on the table more than you earn in half a year.
ev.j_scr_forgery.report: Tell the dead man's family everything
ev.j_scr_records_audit.title: Old Records
ev.j_scr_records_audit.text: An inspector is going through years of old scrolls. Your old misstep, a record altered for money, is lying on his desk.
ev.j_scr_records_audit.blame.success: They half believed you: you weren't the one punished, but your standing suffered.
ev.j_scr_records_audit.blame.failure: The client produced a receipt bearing your seal. A fine, disgrace, and lost clients.
ev.j_scr_papyrus.title: Costly Papyrus
ev.j_scr_papyrus.text: Papyrus has gone up in price again. A trader you know whispers that he can get cheap rolls, no questions asked about where they came from.
ev.j_scr_papyrus.text.egypt: Papyrus is a royal monopoly, and the official price has gone up again. A boatman you know whispers that he can bring rolls straight from the Delta marshes, bypassing the treasury.
ev.j_scr_papyrus.text.rome: Papyrus comes from Egypt, and this year it's so scarce that the Senate has appointed men to ration the supply. A trader you know whispers that he can get cheap rolls, no questions asked.
ev.j_scr_papyrus.smuggled.success: The rolls were excellent, and the trader discreet.
ev.j_scr_papyrus.smuggled.failure: The shipment was seized, along with a list of buyers that included your name. A fine and an unpleasant conversation.
ev.j_scr_papyrus.palimpsest: Wash old rolls and write on them again
ev.j_scr_census.title: The Census
ev.j_scr_census.text: A house-by-house census is under way: you go from door to door recording people for the poll tax. The mother of a large family whispers, "Don't write down my youngest son, the tax will ruin us," and presses coins into your hand.
ev.j_scr_census.text.rome: The censors are taking the census, and you're recording citizens and their property. The master of a house asks you to write down less property than he has, since both his taxes and his military service depend on it, and presses coins into your hand.
ev.j_scr_census.report: Record it as it is and report the bribe
ev.j_phys_patient.title: A Noble Patient
ev.j_phys_patient.text: You've been called to the bedside of a nobleman. Three physicians before you threw up their hands. There's a bold remedy you've read about, but if it fails, you'll be the one blamed.
ev.j_phys_patient.bold.success: By morning the fever broke, and within a week the patient walked into the garden himself. The gratitude of the great is measured in more than silver.
ev.j_phys_patient.bold.failure: The patient grew worse, and his family quickly found someone to blame. Talk of ignorant doctors spread through the city.
ev.j_phys_patient.careful: Treat him cautiously, in the usual way
ev.j_phys_poison.title: A Quiet Request
ev.j_phys_poison.text: A rich old man's son asks you for "something so Father won't suffer any more". He won't meet your eyes, and his purse is heavy. You understand what he really means.
ev.j_phys_poison.refuse: Refuse: a physician does not give deadly drugs
ev.j_phys_poison.warn.success: The old man believed you. The heir was sent off to a distant estate, and you became the household's physician.
ev.j_phys_poison.warn.failure: The old man didn't believe you and threw you out, and now the son spreads rumours about you all over the city.
ev.j_phys_poison.chalk: Take the money and give him harmless chalk
ev.j_phys_poison.chalk.success: The son never understood why his father stayed healthy. He had no one to complain to.
ev.j_phys_poison.chalk.failure: The heir saw through the trick. Now you have a dangerous enemy, and he knows you kept silent.
ev.j_phys_debate.title: A Clash of Schools
ev.j_phys_debate.text: A physician from a rival school mocks your methods before a crowd in the square and challenges you to a public debate, with demonstrations.
ev.j_phys_debate.debate.success: You answered calmly and demonstrated everything. The crowd applauded, and your rival left before the debate was over.
ev.j_phys_debate.debate.failure: Your rival was the better speaker. You knew more, but the crowd remembered his jokes, not your arguments.
ev.j_phys_treatise_later.title: Your Book
ev.j_phys_treatise_later.text: Your treatise is being copied in Alexandria and Pergamon. One day a young man from a distant island appeared at your door: he read the book and wants to study with no one but you.
ev.j_rhet_case.title: Two Clients
ev.j_rhet_case.text: Two people came to you the same morning. A rich man, plainly guilty of fraud, offers a huge fee. A poor widow, whose house that same man took, can offer only tears.
ev.j_rhet_case.text.rome: Two people came to you the same morning. A rich man, plainly guilty of fraud, promises a "gift": the law forbids taking fees for advocacy, but no law forbids gifts. A poor widow, whose house he took, can offer only tears.
ev.j_rhet_case.widow.success: The judges gave the widow back her house. Your speech was the talk of the square for a month.
ev.j_rhet_case.widow.failure: The rich man bribed the witnesses, and the case was lost. But people saw whose side you were on.
ev.j_rhet_prosecute.title: A Famous Prosecution
ev.j_rhet_prosecute.text: Provincials have come with a complaint against a former governor: he stripped them bare. They need a prosecutor. The governor is powerful, and his friends offer you a fortune to defend him instead.
ev.j_rhet_prosecute.text.athens: A charge is being prepared against a well-known politician: he pushed an illegal proposal through the Assembly and, they say, took Macedonian money. A prosecutor is needed. Meanwhile his friends offer you a fortune to defend him.
ev.j_rhet_prosecute.text.egypt: The people of a nome complain against a royal strategos who stripped them bare. They need someone to speak against him before the royal court in Alexandria. Meanwhile his friends offer you a fortune to defend him.
ev.j_rhet_prosecute.prosecute.success: Your speech was copied and read all over the city. The accused fled into exile without waiting for the verdict, and you woke up famous.
ev.j_rhet_prosecute.prosecute.failure: The defence was stronger. The accused was acquitted, and now you have a powerful enemy.
ev.j_rhet_enemy_returns.title: The Enemy Returns
ev.j_rhet_enemy_returns.text: The man you once prosecuted is powerful again, or his son has grown up. Now a case is being brought against you.
ev.j_rhet_enemy_returns.fight.success: You turned the charge back on the accusers. The whole court laughed, the judges included.
ev.j_rhet_enemy_returns.fight.failure: The court ruled against you. The fine hit your purse, and your enemies are triumphant.
ev.j_rhet_enemy_returns.retreat: Retire to your estate until it blows over
ev.j_rhet_pupil.title: A Rich Man's Son
ev.j_rhet_pupil.text: A rich father pays handsomely for you to make an orator of his son. The young man is lazy, stumbles over words, and falls asleep over the speeches of Demosthenes.
ev.j_rhet_pupil.teach_hard: Teach him strictly, as you were taught
ev.j_rhet_pupil_grown.title: A Former Pupil
ev.j_rhet_pupil_grown.text: The lazy youth you once drilled in speeches now holds high office. He tells everyone he owes you every good word he speaks, and opens doors for you.
ev.j_pri_omen.title: A Bad Omen
ev.j_pri_omen.text: Before an important undertaking of the city, you perform a sacrifice. The signs are bad, as bad as they come. And the man who ordered the rite is watching you, waiting for only one answer.
ev.j_pri_omen.text.rome: Before the army marches out, you read the entrails of the sacrificial animal. The liver is bad, as bad as they come. And the magistrate is watching you, waiting for only one answer.
ev.j_pri_omen.text.egypt: A royal official ordered a rite at the temple before a great undertaking, but the sacred bull refuses its feed: a bad sign, as bad as they come. And the official is watching you, waiting for only one answer.
ev.j_pri_omen.repeat: Suggest repeating the rite until the gods relent
ev.j_pri_omen.repeat.success: The second time the signs were better. Everyone breathed a sigh of relief, and no one had to lie.
ev.j_pri_omen.repeat.failure: The second time and the third, the signs were bad. The client left in a rage.
ev.j_pri_omen_echo.title: The Gods Remember
ev.j_pri_omen_echo.text: The undertaking you once declared favoured by the signs has ended in disaster. The city remembers that rite, and someone is already whispering your name.
ev.j_pri_omen_echo.blame: Say the client himself demanded "good" signs
ev.j_pri_omen_echo.blame.success: Many remembered his impatience. The city's anger turned on him.
ev.j_pri_omen_echo.blame.failure: No one believed you, and he swore revenge.
ev.j_pri_treasury.title: Gifts to the Gods
ev.j_pri_treasury.text: You've noticed offerings disappearing from the temple treasury: silver cups, coins from the offering box. Only the treasurer has the keys.
ev.j_pri_treasury.report.success: The treasurer was removed, the losses made good, and the keys entrusted to you.
ev.j_pri_treasury.report.failure: The treasurer turned out to be related to powerful people. The matter was hushed up, and now you're seen as a troublemaker.
ev.j_pri_treasury.share: Hint to the treasurer that silence has a price
ev.j_pri_treasury.quiet_fix: Talk to the treasurer in private and make him return it
ev.j_pri_treasury_later.title: The Temple Inventory
ev.j_pri_treasury_later.text: The new authorities ordered the temple treasures counted again against the old inventories. The shortfall came to light, and the treasurer named you.
ev.j_pri_treasury_later.text.athens: The new authorities ordered the temple treasures counted again against the old inventories carved in stone. The shortfall came to light, and the treasurer named you.
ev.j_pri_treasury_later.deny.success: The treasurer's word against yours, and they believed you.
ev.j_pri_treasury_later.deny.failure: Witnesses had overheard your talks. Disgrace and a heavy fine.
ev.j_pri_new_cult.title: New Gods
ev.j_pri_new_cult.text: New gods have come to the city, and people flock to their shrine, including those who once brought offerings to your temple.
ev.j_pri_new_cult.text.rome: More and more Romans worship the Egyptian goddess Isis. The Senate has ordered her altars torn down more than once, but they keep going up again, and people flock to them, including those who once came to your temple.
ev.j_pri_new_cult.text.athens: Egyptian merchants have been granted the right to build a shrine of Isis in Piraeus, and Athenians flock to it, including those who once came to your temple.
ev.j_pri_new_cult.text.egypt: The Ptolemaic kings honour a new god, Sarapis, who unites Osiris, the sacred Apis bull and Greek features. His sanctuaries grow rich, while fewer and fewer come to your temple.
ev.j_pri_new_cult.oppose: Speak out against the foreign rites
ev.j_land_vines.title: Vineyards
ev.j_land_vines.text: Wine fetches a good price: merchants buy it by the amphora for distant lands. You could turn your wheat fields over to vines, but the first real harvest is years away.
ev.j_land_vines.text.rome: Wine fetches a good price: Italian amphorae sail to Gaul, where, they say, people pay fortunes for them. You could turn your wheat fields over to vines, but the first real harvest is years away.
ev.j_land_vines_harvest.title: The First Wine
ev.j_land_vines_harvest.text: The vines have finally come into their strength. Amphorae bearing your stamp are loaded onto ships, and merchants bid for every one.
ev.j_land_tenants.title: The Tenants' Bad Year
ev.j_land_tenants.text: Hail has flattened the crops, and your tenants have come to you as a whole village: they can't pay. Their elder twists his cap in his hands and stares at the ground.
ev.j_land_tenants.text.egypt: The Nile flood was low, the crops failed, and your tenants have come to you as a whole village: they can't pay. Their elder twists the hem of his cloak and stares at the ground.
ev.j_land_tenants.evict: Evict the defaulters and find new tenants
ev.j_land_tenants.seed_loan: Lend them seed grain at interest
ev.j_land_tenants.seed_loan.success: The next year was generous, and the loan came back with profit.
ev.j_land_tenants.seed_loan.failure: The next year was bad too. The grain is lost, and the debt still hangs.
ev.j_land_tenants_loyal.title: Your Own People
ev.j_land_tenants_loyal.text: The tenants remember how you forgave their arrears in a hard year. When the harvest was good, they brought you more than was due of their own accord, and the elder said, "This is for that year."
ev.j_mag_games.title: A Festival at Your Own Expense
ev.j_mag_games.text: Your office obliges you to give the people a festival. The treasury gave a little; the rest comes from your purse. The people remember the generous and never forget the stingy.
ev.j_mag_games.text.rome: You are aedile, and custom demands that you give games: gladiators, beasts, handouts. The treasury gave a little; the rest comes from your purse. The people remember the generous and never forget the stingy.
ev.j_mag_games.text.athens: The choregia has fallen to you: preparing a chorus for the Dionysia at your own expense. Costumes, a chorus master, months of rehearsals. The city remembers generous choregoi and never forgets stingy ones.
ev.j_mag_games.text.egypt: You've been chosen gymnasiarch: a whole year of oil for the gymnasium, contests and prizes, all at your expense. The city remembers the generous and never forgets the stingy.
ev.j_mag_games.borrow: Borrow from moneylenders and put on a grand show
ev.j_mag_games_echo.title: The People Remember
ev.j_mag_games_echo.text: Years later people still recall your festival. Whole districts vote for you, and your new office brings not only honour but income.
ev.j_mag_creditors.title: Creditors at the Door
ev.j_mag_creditors.text: The moneylenders who financed that festival will wait no longer. Their men sit in your house with tablets, and the interest has grown so large it's frightening to count.
ev.j_mag_creditors.province: Secure a posting to a province and pay from there
ev.j_mag_creditors.province.success: A year in the province, and the debts were cleared, with enough left for a new roof.
ev.j_mag_creditors.province.failure: You cleared the debts, but the provincials' complaints of extortion reached the capital.
ev.j_mag_election.title: The Election
ev.j_mag_election.text: The election for high office is coming. Your rival is already handing out money and feasting the voters. Your friends say you can't win without money.
ev.j_mag_election.text.athens: The election of generals is coming: unlike other offices, these are decided by a show of hands rather than by lot. Your rival is already feasting the voters. Your friends say you can't win without money.
ev.j_mag_election.text.egypt: The seat at the head of the city council is vacant. It will be decided in Alexandria, and your rival has already sent gifts to the right people at court. Your friends say you can't win without money.
ev.j_mag_election.bribe.success: You won. Though some remember what it cost.
ev.j_mag_election.bribe.failure: Your rival paid more. The money is gone, and the office is his.
ev.j_mag_election.honest: Win them over with speeches and deeds
ev.j_mag_election.honest.success: Your speeches drew crowds. You won honestly, and everyone knows it.
ev.j_mag_election.honest.failure: They listened to your speeches gladly and voted for the man who fed them.
ev.j_mag_ambitus_trial.title: Charged with Bribery
ev.j_mag_ambitus_trial.text: Old rivals have dug up how you bought votes in that election. You're charged with electoral bribery, and the penalty could be exile.
ev.j_mag_ambitus_trial.self.success: You mocked the accusers so deftly that the judges acquitted you almost unanimously.
ev.j_mag_ambitus_trial.self.failure: The verdict was harsh: a huge fine and a stain on your name.
ev.j_mat_loan.title: A Loan
ev.j_mat_loan.text: A neighbour's wife asks to borrow money: her husband has a venture about to turn a profit. You have money of your own, and the decision is yours.
ev.j_mat_loan.interest: Lend at interest, with a written contract
ev.j_mat_loan.friendly: Lend without interest, as a friend
ev.j_mat_loan_repaid.title: The Loan Repaid
ev.j_mat_loan_repaid.text: Your neighbour repaid the loan in full, with interest, just as the contract said. Her husband's business has prospered, and now others come to you for loans too.
ev.j_mat_estate.title: Mistress of the Estate
ev.j_mat_estate.text: {npc}, your husband, has been away on official duties for two years, and the estate is in your hands. A buyer offers to take the whole harvest at once: cheap, but in cash. In a couple of months prices may rise.
ev.j_mat_estate.wait.success: Prices rose, just as you thought. When {npc} came home, he counted the takings again and again and couldn't believe his eyes.
ev.j_mat_estate.wait.failure: Prices fell. The harvest went for almost nothing, but at least the granaries are empty.
ev.j_mat_estate.write: Write to your husband and wait for his answer
ev.j_mat_festival.title: A Women's Festival
ev.j_mat_festival.text: The women of the city have chosen you to organize a festival. A great honour, but the costs are considerable: sacrifices, food, lamps burning all night.
ev.j_mat_festival.text.rome: The noblewomen of Rome have chosen you to organize the night rites of the Good Goddess, a festival no man may attend. A great honour, but the costs are considerable: sacrifices, food, lamps burning all night.
ev.j_mat_festival.text.athens: The citizens' wives have chosen you to organize the Thesmophoria, Demeter's festival, which no man may attend. A great honour, but the costs are considerable: sacrifices, food, lamps burning all night.
ev.j_mat_festival.text.egypt: The women of the city have chosen you to organize the festival of Isis. A great honour, but the costs are considerable: sacrifices, food, lamps burning all night.
ev.j_hs_cup.title: The Broken Cup
ev.j_hs_cup.text: You were polishing your master's favourite painted cup, and it slipped from your hands. Shards on the floor. No one else is in the room yet.
ev.j_hs_cup.confess.success: Your master winced but valued your honesty. "I have plenty of cups, but few honest servants," he said.
ev.j_hs_cup.confess.failure: Your master was in a foul mood. The punishment was severe, and you couldn't forget that day for a long time.
ev.j_hs_cup.dog.success: The dog was banished to the yard for a week, and you felt a little ashamed, before the dog.
ev.j_hs_cup.dog.failure: Someone had seen the dog asleep in the garden all day. The lie came out.
ev.j_hs_secret.title: An Overheard Conversation
ev.j_hs_secret.text: While serving wine, you heard what your master discussed with a guest: a deal no one was supposed to know about. Next morning at the market, a man working for your master's rival approached you and offered silver for the details.
ev.j_hs_secret.sell.success: The silver is hidden somewhere safe. Only now every glance from your master seems suspicious.
ev.j_hs_secret.sell.failure: Your master found out where his secrets leaked from. The punishment was harsh, and his trust will never return.
ev.j_hs_secret.tell_master: Tell your master about the offer
ev.j_hs_letters.title: Outside the Schoolroom
ev.j_hs_letters.text: You've been told to walk the master's son to school and wait until lessons end. You sit by the door and hear the teacher going over the letters with the children.
ev.j_hs_secretary.title: A Literate Slave
ev.j_hs_secretary.text: Your master urgently needs someone to write letters and keep accounts, and his secretary has fallen ill. No one in the house knows you can read and write.
ev.j_fs_rations.title: Short Rations
ev.j_fs_rations.text: The overseer has cut the bread ration again and sells the surplus on the side. Tomorrow the master comes to the estate, for the first time in a year.
ev.j_fs_rations.speak.success: The master had the sacks counted, and the overseer had to answer for it. The rations were restored, and people look at you with respect now.
ev.j_fs_rations.speak.failure: The master listened and left, and the overseer stayed. You were the one who paid for it.
ev.j_fs_runaway_friend.title: A Night Conversation
ev.j_fs_runaway_friend.text: A friend whispers to you at night: he's going to the hills, to join the runaways. He needs bread for the road, your bread for three days.
ev.j_fs_runaway_friend.help: Give him the bread and keep quiet
ev.j_fs_runaway_friend.help.success: In the morning he was missing at the count. They questioned you, but you knew nothing. They say he made it.
ev.j_fs_runaway_friend.help.failure: He was caught on the second day and couldn't hold out; he named you. Both of you were punished.
ev.j_fs_vines.title: A Vinedresser's Hands
ev.j_fs_vines.text: The overseer has noticed how deftly you prune vines and graft cuttings. A good vinedresser is valued above everyone on the estate.
ev.j_glad_fix.title: A Fixed Fight
ev.j_glad_fix.text: The lanista took you aside: tomorrow you're to lose to the crowd's favourite. Big money has been bet on him, and not only by the lanista.
ev.j_glad_fix.fight.success: You won, and the stands roared. The lanista ground his teeth, but a fighter like you doesn't come cheap.
ev.j_glad_fix.fight.failure: The crowd's favourite turned out to be stronger, no fix needed. You left the arena barely alive.
ev.j_glad_fix.show: Agree with your opponent on a showy fight
ev.j_glad_fix.show.success: You fought so that the crowd held its breath, and in the end you were both released alive and rewarded.
ev.j_glad_fix.show.failure: Your opponent didn't keep to the deal and struck for real.
ev.j_glad_recruit.title: A Newcomer at the School
ev.j_glad_recruit.text: A newcomer has been brought to the gladiator school, a boy taken prisoner. At night he cries in a corner, and by day he can't hold the wooden sword.
ev.j_glad_recruit.distance: Don't get attached: tomorrow you might be set against each other
ev.j_glad_recruit_later.title: Greetings from a Pupil
ev.j_glad_recruit_later.text: That newcomer you taught at the school survived and won his freedom. He sought you out and brought a purse: "You taught me how to live."
ev.j_glad_munus.title: The Great Games
ev.j_glad_munus.text: The giver of the games has announced the main fight of the festival: you against a famous fighter whose name is scrawled in charcoal on the walls. Half of Rome will come to watch.
ev.j_glad_munus.fight_hard.success: You won. The crowd chants your name, and in the giver's box they're whispering about something.
ev.j_glad_munus.fight_hard.failure: You lost, but fought so well that the crowd waved their cloths, and the giver of the games granted you your life.
ev.j_glad_munus.show: Save your strength and defend with style
ev.j_glad_munus.show.success: The fight was long and beautiful. Both of you were released with a reward.
ev.j_glad_munus.show.failure: Your opponent broke through your guard. You survived, but the wounds took months to heal.
ev.j_glad_rudis.title: The Wooden Sword
ev.j_glad_rudis.text: After yet another victory the stands demand, "Freedom!" The giver of the games rises in his box and hands you the wooden sword, the rudis, the sign that you no longer belong to the arena.
ev.j_glad_rudis.tavern: Open a tavern by the amphitheatre
ev.j_glad_rudis.fight_on: Stay in the arena, but for pay, as a free man
ev.j_up_centurion.title: The Vine Staff
ev.j_up_centurion.text: The legate has noticed your service: a centurion's post is open, and the vine staff could be yours. The tribune's clerk hints that a gift would speed things up.
ev.j_up_centurion.merit: Wait for a decision on merit
ev.j_up_centurion.merit.success: A month later you were handed the centurion's staff before the ranks. And no one can say you bought it.
ev.j_up_centurion.merit.failure: The post went to someone who wasn't stingy. You stay in the ranks.
ev.j_up_officer.title: Commander of a Company
ev.j_up_officer.text: Your company's commander has fallen, and the soldiers are looking at you. Your superiors offer you his post.
ev.j_up_officer.text.egypt: A company commander's post is open in Ptolemy's army, and your superiors offer it to you. The soldiers already look at you differently.
ev.j_up_workshop.title: A Workshop of Your Own
ev.j_up_workshop.text: The old master half the city orders from is retiring. He's ready to sell the workshop with all its tools and apprentices, to you, if you can agree on a price.
ev.j_up_workshop.buy: Buy it with your own money
ev.j_up_workshop.loan: Pay part and borrow the rest
ev.j_own_debt.title: The Loan Falls Due
ev.j_own_debt.text: The time has come to pay for the workshop. The lender is polite but unyielding, and the interest has grown over the years.
ev.j_own_debt.partner: Give the lender a share of the business
ev.j_own_debt.sell: Sell the workshop and work for others again
ev.j_up_ship.title: A Ship of Your Own
ev.j_up_ship.text: A sturdy merchant ship is for sale in the harbour: its owner has grown rich and is retiring. You can buy it outright, or go in on shares with partners.
ev.j_up_official.title: A Post in the Chancery
ev.j_up_official.text: A post has opened in the chancery: documents, a seal, a salary and respect. Rumour has it the post can simply be bought.
ev.j_up_official.text.rome: A post as clerk to the quaestors has opened. In Rome such posts are bought and sold almost like houses, but sometimes they're given on merit.
ev.j_up_official.text.egypt: A post as royal scribe of the nome has opened: keeping records of land, taxes and harvests. They say the right people in the strategos's office expect a gift.
ev.j_up_official.merit.success: You were tested on a difficult document and did better than anyone. The post is yours.
ev.j_up_official.merit.failure: The post went to the nephew of someone influential.
ev.j_up_overseer.title: Over Your Own
ev.j_up_overseer.text: The master calls for you: the old overseer is aged and ill. You're offered his place: the keys to the storerooms and authority over the other slaves, your comrades of yesterday.
ev.j_cent_harsh.title: Your Century
ev.j_cent_harsh.text: The men of your century are grumbling: the service is hard, the pay is late. Other centurions rule their men by fear and take money for exemptions from duty.
ev.j_cent_harsh.strict.success: Your century is the best at inspection. They fear you, but they respect you.
ev.j_cent_harsh.strict.failure: One night someone from your own ranks ambushed you by your tent. The culprits were never found.
ev.j_cent_harsh.fair: End the extortion and be fair
ev.j_cent_mutiny.title: Mutiny in the Camp
ev.j_cent_mutiny.text: A hard winter, late pay, and the legion has exploded. The soldiers have surrounded the centurions' tents, and your name is among the first they shout.
ev.j_cent_mutiny.face.success: You came out unarmed and spoke to them as one soldier to another. They let you through, and later they even stood up for you.
ev.j_cent_mutiny.face.failure: Stones flew from the crowd. Your own men carried you to the infirmary, and the wound took long to heal.
ev.j_cent_mutiny.pay: Buy them off with your own money
ev.j_cent_mutiny.hide: Take refuge with a neighbouring legion
ev.j_cent_frontier.title: The Chief Across the River
ev.j_cent_frontier.text: You command a small fort on the frontier. The chief of a local tribe offers trade: furs and amber in exchange for wine. But his men cross the river a little too easily.
ev.j_cent_frontier.trust.success: Trade flourished. The chief even warned you of a raid by a neighbouring tribe.
ev.j_cent_frontier.trust.failure: Warriors came disguised as traders. The fort held, but you were wounded.
ev.j_cent_primus.title: The First Spear
ev.j_cent_primus.text: You're appointed primus pilus, the senior centurion of the legion. One year in that post, and you retire with a huge reward and the rank of an equestrian.
ev.j_off_pay.title: Soldiers Without Pay
ev.j_off_pay.text: The pay hasn't come again, and the mercenaries of your company are muttering. Yesterday someone said aloud that the neighbouring king pays on time.
ev.j_off_pay.own_purse: Pay them from your own purse
ev.j_off_pay.promise.success: Your word still counts for something. The soldiers waited, and the pay arrived.
ev.j_off_pay.promise.failure: The soldiers didn't believe you. In the commotion your head was split open, and part of the company deserted.
ev.j_off_pay.arrest.success: The ringleaders were taken quietly. The rest fell silent, though they love you no more for it.
ev.j_off_pay.arrest.failure: The ringleaders resisted, and you took a beating in the scuffle yourself.
ev.j_off_garrison.title: A Distant Fortress
ev.j_off_garrison.text: You're offered command of a garrison at the very edge of the realm. Double pay, plenty of honour, and you won't see your family for a long time.
ev.j_off_garrison.text.egypt: You're offered command of the garrison on the island of Elephantine, at the First Cataract of the Nile, on the Nubian frontier. Double pay, plenty of honour, and you won't see your family for a long time.
ev.j_off_garrison_later.title: The Return
ev.j_off_garrison_later.text: Your term at the distant fortress is over. You came back sunburnt, with a reward and stories people now listen to with bated breath.
ev.j_own_workers.title: Hands for the Workshop
ev.j_own_workers.text: There are more orders than hands. You could buy slaves at the market, as everyone does, or hire free day labourers, though that costs more.
ev.j_own_contract.title: A Public Contract
ev.j_own_contract.text: The city needs a large order of roof tiles and pipes for the new public baths. The contract will go to a single workshop. The official in charge hints that the matter can be "arranged".
ev.j_own_contract.bid_low.success: You calculated everything to the last coin and finished on time. A good profit, and an even better reputation.
ev.j_own_contract.bid_low.failure: The price was too low. You completed the contract at a loss.
ev.j_own_contract.fair_bid.success: Your offer was the best. The contract is yours.
ev.j_own_contract.fair_bid.failure: The contract went to whoever "arranged" it.
ev.j_own_contract_scandal.title: The Contracts Affair
ev.j_own_contract_scandal.text: That official was arrested for bribery, and under questioning he named everyone who paid him. Your name is on the list.
ev.j_own_contract_scandal.deny.success: No proof was found. You got off with a fright.
ev.j_own_contract_scandal.deny.failure: A receipt turned up. A huge fine and disgrace.
ev.j_ship_pirates.title: Pirates
ev.j_ship_pirates.text: News has come: your ship has been seized by pirates off the coast of Cilicia. The cargo has already been sold, and they demand a ransom for the crew.
ev.j_ship_pirates.ransom: Pay the ransom for the crew
ev.j_ship_pirates.rescue: Hire men to take the ship back
ev.j_ship_pirates.rescue.success: The night raid succeeded: the ship and the crew are yours again.
ev.j_ship_pirates.rescue.failure: The hired men took the money and never came back. The ship is lost.
ev.j_ship_pirates.abandon: Write off both ship and men
ev.j_ship_state.title: The State's Grain
ev.j_ship_state.text: The city needs ships to bring in grain. Those who carry the public grain are promised steady pay and honours. A private voyage could bring twice as much, or nothing.
ev.j_ship_state.text.rome: Rome needs ships to bring grain from Egypt and Africa. Those who carry grain for the distributions are promised steady pay, and if a ship is lost in a storm, compensation from the treasury. A private voyage could bring twice as much, or nothing.
ev.j_ship_state.text.athens: Athens needs ships to bring grain from the Black Sea: by law, grain bought by Athenian shipowners must go to Piraeus. Public voyages pay steadily. A private voyage could bring twice as much, or nothing.
ev.j_ship_state.text.egypt: The king needs ships to carry grain from the nomes to Alexandria. The pay is steady, and faithful service is promised honours. A private voyage could bring twice as much, or nothing.
ev.j_ship_state.private.success: You guessed right with both the goods and the wind. The profit makes the public pay look like small change.
ev.j_ship_state.private.failure: Prices in port fell just before you arrived. The voyage didn't pay for itself.
ev.j_ship_state.overload: Overload the ships beyond the limit
ev.j_ship_state.overload.success: The ships made it, though they sat in the water up to the gunwales. A huge profit.
ev.j_ship_state.overload.failure: The overloaded ship ran aground off a cape. The cargo was lost, the crew barely escaped, and now people speak ill of you.
ev.j_ship_state_later.title: Honours for a Shipowner
ev.j_ship_state_later.text: For years of faithful service to the city you've been rewarded: an honorary inscription, exemption from public duties, and a seat in the front rows at festivals.
ev.j_offc_bribe.title: A Heavy Purse
ev.j_offc_bribe.text: A rich landowner asks you to record his lands as smaller than they are, so his tax will be lower. He sets a purse on the table and smiles: "Everyone does it."
ev.j_offc_bribe.report.success: Your superiors valued your honesty. The landowner was fined, and you were commended.
ev.j_offc_bribe.report.failure: Your superior turned out to be the landowner's friend. The matter was hushed up, and you made enemies.
ev.j_offc_harvest.title: Harvest Figures
ev.j_offc_harvest.text: Your superior demands that you record the district's harvest as higher than it is: those above like good reports. But taxes are reckoned from the reports, and the villages will have to give up their last.
ev.j_offc_harvest.truth.success: An inspection confirmed your figures. Your superior said nothing, and those above remembered you as an honest man.
ev.j_offc_harvest.truth.failure: Your superior was furious, and your report "got lost". Now you're passed over for rewards.
ev.j_offc_harvest.middle: Find a middle way: raise the figures just a little
ev.j_offc_harvest.middle.success: Everyone was almost satisfied, a rare art.
ev.j_offc_harvest.middle.failure: Everyone was dissatisfied: your superior and the villages alike.
ev.j_offc_villages.title: Empty Villages
ev.j_offc_villages.text: The tax reckoned from the inflated figures has proved unbearable. Farmers are abandoning their fields, some seeking refuge in the temples, some in the marshes. The village headmen come to you.
ev.j_offc_villages.help: Help the villages with your own money
ev.j_ovs_quota.title: More Work
ev.j_ovs_quota.text: The master demands a third more from this year's harvest than last year's. To manage it, you'll have to drive people from dawn to dark.
ev.j_ovs_quota.shield: Take the blame for the shortfall yourself
ev.j_ovs_quota.smart.success: You split people into teams and set up a contest. They brought in more, without needless misery.
ev.j_ovs_quota.smart.failure: The scheme failed. The master is displeased, and so are the people.
ev.j_ovs_will.title: The Master's Promise
ev.j_ovs_will.text: After some wine, the master promises that if the estate prospers, he'll free you in his will. It's not the first time he's said so.
ev.j_ovs_will.work_hard: Work with all your strength and wait
ev.j_ovs_will.buy_now: Offer to buy your freedom now
ev.j_ovs_will.buy_now.success: The master laughed but took the money. A week later you stood before the magistrate a free person.
ev.j_ovs_will.buy_now.failure: "Too soon," said the master, and never returned to the subject.
